lines.text: This animal has 9 brains, 3 hearts, and blue blood.

parts.tts: This animal has nine brains, three hearts, and blue blood.
parts.heard: This animal has 9 brains, 3 hearts, and blue blood.

lines.text: The octopus has around 500 million neurons, about as many as a dog.

parts.tts: The octopus has around five hundred million neurons, about as many as a dog.
parts.heard: The octopus has around 500 million neurons, about as many as a dog.

lines.text: But two thirds of them aren't in its head. They're in its arms.

parts.tts: But two thirds of them aren't in its head. They're in its arms.
parts.heard: But two-thirds of them aren't in its head. They're in its arms.

lines.text: Each arm has its own mini brain. It can taste, touch and move on its own.

parts.tts: Each arm has its own mini brain. It can taste, touch and move on its own.
parts.heard: Each arm has its own mini-brain. It can taste, touch, and move on its own.

lines.text: But the main brain can still step in and take control.

parts.tts: But the main brain can still step in and take control.
parts.heard: but the main brain can still step in and take control.

lines.text: 3 hearts: two pump blood past the gills, one pumps it around the body.

parts.tts: three hearts: two pump blood past the gills, one pumps it around the body.
parts.heard: Three hearts, two pump blood past the gills, one pumps it around the body.

lines.text: But when it swims, that body heart goes quiet.

parts.tts: But when it swims, that body heart goes quiet.
parts.heard: but when it swims, that body heart goes quiet.

lines.text: And the blood is blue, because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron.

parts.tts: And the blood is blue, because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron.
parts.heard: and the blood is blue because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron.

lines.text: But in cold water with little oxygen, copper actually works better.

parts.tts: But in cold water with little oxygen, copper actually works better.
parts.heard: But in cold water with little oxygen, copper actually works better.

lines.text: 9 brains, 3 hearts, blue blood... and zero bones.
